newsitem.title: INDIA: India RBI to release weekly data on intervention.
newsitem.headline: India RBI to release weekly data on intervention.

text.p: India's central bank said on Friday it planned to shortly start releasing weekly details of its intervention in the country's forex markets.

"The extent, the pace and the manner of correction of the exchange rate will have to be taken in conjunction with money supply, since price stability continues to be the dominant objective of monetary policy," Deputy Governor Y.V. Reddy of the Reserve Bank of India told a meeting of forex dealers.
"For my part I am happy to announce that henceforth the Reserve Bank will make available weekly data relating to its intervention in the forex market."
